title: Localization of the explicit finite-stage pullback compositor
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbb Q_\ell$, scheme maps $Z\xrightarrow{h}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$ with $\ell$ invertible on every residue field, a common-stage constructible object $M$ on $Y$, and a finite stage $L$ containing its stage [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. The forward hom of commonStagePullbackRationalComposition, the explicit fixed-stage rational pullback compositor [lem-zl-common-stage-pullback-comp-rational-naturality], is heterogeneously equal to the localization at $L$ of the selected integral compositor [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition] evaluated on the integral object underlying $M_L$. The source and target identifications are exactly the rational pullback object equalities of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0941; finite-stage composition convention and localization of the prescribed integral composition.

proof.text: Unfold only the definition of the explicit rational compositor. It is eqToIso of the source rational pullback object equality, followed by the localization mapIso of the selected integral compositor, followed by the inverse eqToIso of the target rational pullback object equality. Its forward hom is therefore the conjugate of the localized integral hom by equality morphisms. Apply CategoryTheory.conj_eqToHom_iff_heq to those two object equalities. The required ordinary equality of the conjugate expression is reflexive.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStagePullbackRationalComposition_localization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y)
    (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω) (hM : M.stage ≤ L) :
    HEq (commonStagePullbackRationalComposition l Ω h f L M hM).hom
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) Z).map
        (((integralPullbackComposition l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)).choose h f).hom.app
          (M.toStage hM).obj))
